/.en: DKPS designs professional Push-to-Talk communication systems connecting radios, cellular networks, a PTT platform and dispatch for teams, sites and vehicles.
/.it: DKPS progetta sistemi Push-to-Talk professionali che collegano radio, rete cellulare, piattaforma PTT e dispatch per team, sedi e veicoli.

/system.en: Explore how DKPS combines devices, cellular connectivity, PTT software, groups and dispatch into a communication system built around an operation.
/system.it: Scopri come DKPS unisce dispositivi, connettività cellulare, software PTT, gruppi e dispatch in un sistema costruito attorno all’operatività.

/platform.en: See how a PTT platform can organise communication groups, user roles and dispatch access for field teams and control rooms.
/platform.it: Scopri come una piattaforma PTT organizza gruppi di comunicazione, ruoli degli utenti e accesso al dispatch per team e sale controllo.

/devices.en: Explore professional radios, body cameras and accessories for logistics, warehouses, security and mountain operations. DKPS selects equipment around the system.
/devices.it: Esplora radio professionali, bodycam e accessori per logistica, magazzini, sicurezza e operazioni in montagna. DKPS sceglie i dispositivi per il sistema.

/devices/logistics.en: Explore radios and accessories to consider for drivers, vehicles, depots and transport dispatch within a professional communication system.
/devices/logistics.it: Esplora radio e accessori da valutare per autisti, veicoli, depositi e dispatch dei trasporti in un sistema di comunicazione professionale.

/devices/warehousing.en: Explore portable radios, headsets and accessories to consider for warehouse, loading and yard teams.
/devices/warehousing.it: Esplora radio portatili, cuffie e accessori da valutare per team di magazzino, carico e piazzale.

/devices/security.en: Explore radios, discreet audio, body cameras and accessories to consider for patrols, supervisors and security control rooms.
/devices/security.it: Esplora radio, audio discreto, bodycam e accessori da valutare per pattuglie, responsabili e sale controllo della sicurezza.

/devices/mountain.en: Explore vehicle radios, handheld devices, body cameras and audio accessories to consider for ski lifts, snowcats and mountain response teams.
/devices/mountain.it: Esplora radio veicolari e portatili, bodycam e accessori audio da valutare per impianti, gatti delle nevi e squadre in montagna.

/connectivity.en: Learn how cellular connectivity links radios and mobile teams across sites and vehicles within a DKPS Push-to-Talk system.
/connectivity.it: Scopri come la connettività cellulare collega radio e team mobili tra sedi e veicoli in un sistema Push-to-Talk DKPS.

/industries.en: Communication requirements for logistics, hospitality, manufacturing, security and other operations with teams, sites and vehicles to coordinate.
/industries.it: Esigenze di comunicazione per logistica, hospitality, industria, sicurezza e altre attività che coordinano team, sedi e veicoli.

/solutions.en: Explore operational communication needs: connecting multiple sites, coordinating vehicles, supporting international teams and centralising dispatch.
/solutions.it: Esplora le esigenze di comunicazione operativa: collegare più sedi, coordinare veicoli, supportare team internazionali e centralizzare il dispatch.

/plans.en: Understand the factors DKPS considers when planning devices, connectivity, PTT groups, permissions and support for an organisation.
/plans.it: Scopri gli elementi che DKPS valuta nel progettare dispositivi, connettività, gruppi PTT, permessi e assistenza per un’organizzazione.

/about.en: Learn about DKPS Communications and its approach to designing professional Push-to-Talk systems around real operational requirements.
/about.it: Conosci DKPS Communications e il suo approccio alla progettazione di sistemi Push-to-Talk professionali basati sulle esigenze operative.

/contact.en: Tell DKPS how your teams, sites and vehicles work through a guided operational brief, then discuss a suitable communication system.
/contact.it: Racconta a DKPS come lavorano team, sedi e veicoli con un brief operativo guidato e valuta insieme il sistema di comunicazione adatto.

/privacy.en: Read how DKPS Communications handles personal data submitted through the website and its operational contact brief.
/privacy.it: Leggi come DKPS Communications tratta i dati personali inviati tramite il sito e il brief operativo di contatto.
